question: 在复杂规划任务中，显式软约束提示能否提升任务成功率？
searchTerm: LLM soft constraints complex planning benchmark

papers.title: Synthetic Study A — Prompting Improves Complex Planning
papers.abstract: On the synthetic Benchmark-S with 200 complex planning tasks, a fixed model using explicit soft-constraint prompts achieved 78% task success, compared with 60% without the prompts. No reranking was applied.

papers.title: Synthetic Study B — Prompting Reduces Complex Planning Success
papers.abstract: On the synthetic Benchmark-S with 200 complex planning tasks, the same fixed model using explicit soft-constraint prompts achieved 55% task success, compared with 60% without the prompts. No reranking was applied.

papers.title: Synthetic Study C — Benefits Only Evaluated on Simple Tasks
papers.abstract: On 200 simple planning tasks from the synthetic Benchmark-S, explicit soft-constraint prompts increased task success from 70% to 83%. Complex planning tasks were not evaluated.

papers.title: Synthetic Study D — Prompting Combined With Reranking
papers.abstract: On the synthetic Benchmark-S with 200 complex planning tasks, explicit soft-constraint prompts combined with an additional reranking stage achieved 82% task success, compared with a 60% baseline that used neither prompts nor reranking. The independent effect of prompting was not measured.

papers.title: Synthetic Study E — A Benchmark Description
papers.abstract: We release the synthetic Benchmark-S and describe its categories of planning tasks. We report no experiments comparing prompts and no task success rates.
